degeneracy_audit.explanation: A cell is degenerate when all 3 leave-one-seed-out rotations select the SAME layer. Then naive_r = (S - a_r)/2 and honest_r = a_r, so the rotation mean is (3/2)(abar - abar) = 0 identically, for any data. Such a cell measures nothing and is excluded from the headline. Every degenerate cell here falls in the NON-SATURATED subgroup (7 of its 12 cells), which is why that subgroup's contaminated mean understates the effect among cells the estimator can see.
degeneracy_audit.permutation_null_interpretation: The per-layer-shuffle null is what this estimator reports when the layer ranking is noise, i.e. the regime of MAXIMAL winner's curse. Degenerate cells whose null sits well above zero are cells where the exact zero reflects a STABLE argmax defeating the estimator, not an absent selection effect.

method_notes.permutation_scheme: Seed labels shuffled INDEPENDENTLY WITHIN EACH LAYER. A global seed relabelling leaves the rotation estimator exactly invariant and would be a no-op null.
